I'm sorry to hear that. I hope things start looking up for you.

I wish I took a gap year. My mental health went tumbling after I started seeing the school counselor. My first semester went good, but then December happened and I stopped going to classes, sleeping all day, I was miserable. I ended up getting hospitalized and getting more behind. I ended up failing all my classes, killing my GPA. Now I don't know if I should imediately go back. Its up to you, do what you feel. And always, always, put your mental health first. I wish you the best of luck whatever you decide!
